requirements.text: The timetable must be clearer and less cluttered for easier tracking of classes.
The system must provide notifications when new grades are available.
There must be a way to give feedback on the modules after the semester.
The timetable must allow users to colour-code classes for easier identification.
The system must provide an option to hide cancelled classes to reduce confusion.
Users must be able to add personal study blocks to the timetable.
The timetable must offer different viewing options, such as a weekly view.
Users must have the option to choose how to receive notifications (app or email), with SMS not preferred.
Notifications must simply inform users when a new grade is posted.
The system must provide reminders for upcoming deadlines a few days before assignments or exams.
Users must be able to rate course content, instructor performance, resources, and overall experience in the feedback system.
The feedback process must be straightforward and ideally in the form of a simple form after the semester ends.
